title: Partner callbacks fail at the top of the hour
root_cause_summary: The client certificate presented to the payments partner expired at 09:30Z; every outbound callback failed TLS handshake from that minute on.

required_evidence.why: the TLS error naming the peer and expiry instant
delivery collapsing at the same minute

red_herrings.why_tempting: the only deploy in the window, and it touched retry logic
